_comment: Curated visual aids for Picture Study (art_music) and History maps/artifacts. wiki_title is the exact Wikipedia article title, resolved client-side via the Wikipedia REST summary API for a live thumbnail rather than a hardcoded image URL — keeps this catalog resilient to file/path changes and doesn't require hosting the images ourselves. If a title's thumbnail ever fails to resolve, the UI falls back to a plain text caption instead of a broken image. Picture study rotates one artist per grade+term (services/ai_service.py's _TERM_ARTISTS) and one of that artist's works per calendar week, in this file's order for that artist — so every rotation artist needs enough works to fill a term without immediate repeats (tests/test_catalog_data_integrity.py pins the floor). Sculpture is picture study too (Rodin): the card shows a photograph of the work, and the description says so plainly so Bede never calls a statue a painting.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
visual_aids.creator: Johannes Vermeer
visual_aids.description: A luminous portrait study — notice the light on her face and the single pearl earring.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Hay Wain
visual_aids.creator: John Constable
visual_aids.description: An English countryside scene — notice the clouds, the water, and the horse-drawn cart.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Mona Lisa
visual_aids.creator: Leonardo da Vinci
visual_aids.description: Study her expression and the hazy landscape behind her.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Starry Night
visual_aids.creator: Vincent van Gogh
visual_aids.description: Notice the swirling sky and the quiet village below.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: American Gothic
visual_aids.creator: Grant Wood
visual_aids.description: A farmer and his daughter — notice their expressions and the house behind them.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The School of Athens
visual_aids.creator: Raphael
visual_aids.description: Philosophers gathered together — can you find Plato and Aristotle in the center?

visual_aids.subject: history
visual_aids.title: The Roman Empire
visual_aids.description: Trace the boundaries on the map — how far did Rome's reach extend?

visual_aids.subject: history
visual_aids.title: The Roman Forum
visual_aids.description: The heart of ancient Roman public life — imagine the crowds and speeches held here.

visual_aids.subject: history
visual_aids.title: Ancient Egypt
visual_aids.description: Find the Nile River on the map — why might a civilization grow up along it?

visual_aids.subject: history
visual_aids.title: Hadrian's Wall
visual_aids.description: A real wall built to mark and defend the edge of an empire.

visual_aids.subject: history
visual_aids.title: The Bayeux Tapestry
visual_aids.description: A stitched record of a real battle — notice how the story unfolds from left to right.

visual_aids.subject: history
visual_aids.title: The Silk Road
visual_aids.description: Trace the trade routes on the map — what kinds of goods and ideas traveled along them?

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Angelus
visual_aids.creator: Jean-François Millet
visual_aids.description: Two farm workers pause at dusk to pray the Angelus — listen for the distant church bell.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Gleaners
visual_aids.creator: Jean-François Millet
visual_aids.description: Three women gather leftover grain after the harvest — notice their bent backs and the golden light.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Sower
visual_aids.creator: Jean-François Millet
visual_aids.description: A sower strides down the hillside scattering seed — the parable of the sower made paint.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Man with a Hoe
visual_aids.creator: Jean-François Millet
visual_aids.description: A laborer rests on his hoe in a rough field — what does his posture tell you about his day?

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Annunciation (San Marco)
visual_aids.creator: Fra Angelico
visual_aids.description: The angel Gabriel greets Mary under a painted arcade — notice the folded wings and the quiet.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Coronation of the Virgin
visual_aids.creator: Fra Angelico
visual_aids.wiki_title: Coronation of the Virgin (Fra Angelico, Louvre)
visual_aids.description: Heaven crowded with saints as Mary is crowned — how many faces can you find looking up?

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The San Marco Altarpiece
visual_aids.creator: Fra Angelico
visual_aids.description: Mary and the Child enthroned among saints — an early painting where figures stand in real space.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Salisbury Cathedral from the Meadows
visual_aids.creator: John Constable
visual_aids.description: A storm passes over the cathedral while a rainbow lands on it — weather and hope in one sky.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Cornfield
visual_aids.creator: John Constable
visual_aids.description: A shepherd boy stops to drink from the stream on the lane — follow the path back into the field.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Sistine Madonna
visual_aids.creator: Raphael
visual_aids.description: Mary carries the Child between parted curtains — and two small angels lean on the ledge below.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Transfiguration
visual_aids.creator: Raphael
visual_aids.description: Christ rises in light above while the crowd below struggles in shadow — two stories in one painting.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Shepherdess with her Flock
visual_aids.creator: Jean-François Millet
visual_aids.description: A shepherdess stands knitting while her sheep graze close behind her as the day ends — notice the low light catching the backs of the flock, and how still and quiet she is in the middle of it.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Winnower
visual_aids.creator: Jean-François Millet
visual_aids.description: A farm worker tosses grain from a wide basket so the wind carries the chaff away — notice the cloud of dust lit by the doorway, and the strength it takes to hold that basket.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Potato Harvest
visual_aids.creator: Jean-François Millet
visual_aids.description: Field workers gather potatoes into sacks across a wide plain as the light goes golden — notice how the flat land stretches to the horizon, and the rhythm of bending and lifting.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Annunciation of Cortona
visual_aids.creator: Fra Angelico
visual_aids.description: The angel Gabriel greets Mary beneath a painted arcade, his words written in gold across the air between them — and look small in the corner, where Adam and Eve walk out of the garden.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Madonna of Humility
visual_aids.creator: Fra Angelico
visual_aids.description: Mary sits low on a cushion rather than on a throne, holding the Child against a shining gold ground — notice the pattern of the cloth and how the gold makes the whole picture feel lit from inside.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Fiesole Altarpiece
visual_aids.creator: Fra Angelico
visual_aids.description: Mary and the Child sit enthroned with saints standing to either side, painted for the friars' own church at Fiesole — notice which figures look at us and which look at the Child.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Deposition of Christ
visual_aids.creator: Fra Angelico
visual_aids.description: Friends gently lower Christ's body from the cross on ladders, with a city and hills glowing behind them — a sorrowful scene painted with great tenderness; notice how carefully every hand supports him.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Flatford Mill (Scene on a Navigable River)
visual_aids.creator: John Constable
visual_aids.description: Boys work a barge horse on the towpath of the River Stour near the mill — notice the big summer sky, the rope, and how much of the picture is water and cloud.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Wivenhoe Park
visual_aids.creator: John Constable
visual_aids.description: A lake with swans, cows grazing, and a house among the trees on a bright day — notice the reflections in the water and how the clouds are painted as carefully as the land.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Vale of Dedham
visual_aids.creator: John Constable
visual_aids.description: A view down the valley to Dedham church tower and the distant sea, framed by tall trees — notice how far your eye can travel, from the figures in front all the way to the horizon.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Lock
visual_aids.creator: John Constable
visual_aids.description: A man leans hard on a lock gate to let a barge through, under a wide, windy sky — notice the effort in his back, and the church tower far off through the trees.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Madonna of the Goldfinch
visual_aids.creator: Raphael
visual_aids.description: Mary reads while the young John the Baptist offers a goldfinch to the Child, with green countryside behind — notice the little bird passing from one child's hands to the other's.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Madonna della Seggiola
visual_aids.creator: Raphael
visual_aids.description: A round picture: Mary hugs the Child close on a chair while the small John the Baptist looks on — notice how everything curves to fit the circle, and how she looks straight at you.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Saint George and the Dragon
visual_aids.creator: Raphael
visual_aids.description: A knight on a rearing white horse drives his lance at the dragon while the princess prays nearby — a small painting full of action; notice the broken lance on the ground and the horse's eye.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Alba Madonna
visual_aids.creator: Raphael
visual_aids.description: A round picture of Mary seated on the ground in open countryside, with the Child and young John the Baptist holding a small cross — notice how calm the wide landscape is behind them.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Thinker
visual_aids.creator: Auguste Rodin
visual_aids.description: A bronze sculpture of a man seated on a rock, chin resting on his hand, deep in thought — this is a statue, not a painting, so notice how the whole body is thinking: the bent back, the tight toes, the heavy hand.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Burghers of Calais
visual_aids.creator: Auguste Rodin
visual_aids.description: A bronze group of six leading men of Calais walking out to hand themselves over and save their city during a siege — notice that each man's face and hands show something different: fear, resolve, grief.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Monument to Balzac
visual_aids.creator: Auguste Rodin
visual_aids.description: A statue of the writer Balzac wrapped in his long dressing gown, head thrown back as if an idea has just arrived — notice how the sculptor left out small details so the shape reads from far away.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: The Cathedral
visual_aids.creator: Auguste Rodin
visual_aids.description: Two right hands, from two different people, rise toward each other and almost touch, leaving an arched space between them like the inside of a church — notice the empty shape the hands make together.

visual_aids.subject: art_music
visual_aids.title: Bust of Victor Hugo
visual_aids.creator: Auguste Rodin
visual_aids.description: A sculpted portrait head — a bust — of the poet Victor Hugo, modelled in plaster while he was an old man — notice the furrowed brow and the beard, and how a sculptor shows a face's character with bumps and hollows instead of colour.
